format: Shared text corpus, read by packages/native/src/tests/text-corpus_test.zig and packages/core/src/tests/text-corpus.test.ts. Rows use only the keys in keys.

A row loads exactly one of text (one chunk), parts (each appended as its own chunk), or ops (EditBuffer edits: ["set", s], ["cursor", row, col in cells], ["insert", s], ["delete"], ["backspace"], ["right"], ["undo_all"] until no history is left, ["repeat", op] until the text stops changing, at most the starting length + 1 times).

It runs once per width method in methods (wcwidth, unicode, no_zwj, unicode_wide; all four when omitted). tab is the tab width (default 4), control is hidden or notation. TypeScript skips no_zwj and control rows, which no public API can set, and counts each skip.
wrap (none, char, word), cols, and offset (first-line offset) set up the view. Any expected value may be an object keyed by width method; a method it does not name is not checked.

Expected values: width (calculateTextWidth of the text, and lineWidthAt(0) for one line), line_widths (lineWidthAt per line), max (lineWidthColsMax), lines ([source line, source column, width, bytes] per virtual line; TypeScript checks the first three), draw (screen rows at cols, trimmed, empty rows dropped; truncate draws one truncated row per line), draw_at ([viewport x, row]: the unwrapped line drawn at that offset equals the full row cut at that cell), select ([start, end, text] in document cells), range ([start, end, getTextRange]), stops ([row, col] that moveRight visits from 0,0), result (the text after ops). draw_text (true, one line of text without tabs): drawText draws the text cell for cell, trailing blanks included, as drawTextBuffer draws its layout (check draw_text), and so does drawChar with the encodeUnicode glyphs placed one after another (check encode); in a buffer 80 cells wide and one cols wide.

Every row also checks: retain (Zig: the virtual lines hold every byte of the input in order, missing only line breaks and, in word wrap, the spaces, tabs, and U+200B between lines), text (TypeScript: getPlainText equals the input with CRLF as LF), chunk_widths (Zig: each virtual chunk measures its width), fit (Zig: a line is wider than cols only when one grapheme takes all its cells), measure (measureForDimensions equals the rendered layout), resize (cols, cols + 2, cols on one view equals a new view), widest (lineWidthColsMax and the unwrapped measureForDimensions equal the widest line; on split rows, also for every 2-part split, and in Zig every 3-part split), fresh (parts and ops rows lay out like the same text loaded as one chunk), and split (when split is true, every 2-part split, and in Zig every 3-part split, at a code-point boundary lays out like one chunk).

bug lists [check, defect, methods]: that check must fail for those methods (all when missing), the suite fails when it passes, and each entry must reverse a check that ran. Every other check of the row must pass. retain, chunk_widths, fit, measure, resize, and widest cannot be reversed. defect is a GitHub issue (#N) or a slug.
checks counts how many times each runner runs each check (skipped counts TypeScript's skipped row and method pairs), so a runner change cannot skip one silently.
